indices: 貴方(あなた)[01]{あなた} が 金持ち でも[02] 貧乏 でも[02] 私(わたし)[01] に取って{にとって} は 同じ[01] 事(こと) です

original: 私の妻が、貧乏の最中、子供を産んで、寝ている時、私が、幾日か、飯菜を作って、その料理の種類の豊富さと味のよさとに、びっくりさせたものである。

en.text: My wife gave birth to a child when we were very poor. While she was sleeping, I cooked rice and vegetables for several days and surprised her with the variety and taste of my cooking.

original: 一円盗んで見に行く決心をしたが、貧乏の家に盗める一円なんぞ有ろう筈がない。

en.text: I had resolved to steal one yen to go see it, but we were poor and there was no way I would find one yen to steal around our house.

original: 貧乏は諸悪の根源。

en.text: Poverty is the root of all evil.

original: 彼は若い頃貧乏だったようだ。

en.text: It seems that he was poor in his youth.

original: 彼は終生貧乏のままだった。

en.text: He remained poor all his life.

original: 貧乏だからといって人を軽蔑するものではない。

en.text: You should not despise a man because he is poor.

original: 彼は貧乏極まりない。

en.text: He is as poor as can be.
He's as poor as can be.

indices: 彼(かれ) は 貧乏 極まりない

original: 彼女は貧乏ではない。

en.text: She isn't poor.
She's not poor.

indices: 彼女 は 貧乏 では無い{ではない}

original: アジャイは貧乏だ。

en.text: Ajay is poor.

original: トムはメアリーが金目当ての女だと知ってがっかりし、メアリーはトムが貧乏だと知ってがっかりした。

en.text: Tom was sad when he discovered that Mary was a gold digger and Mary was sad when she discovered that Tom was poor.

original: なぜなら友達も皆貧乏だったからです。

en.text: That is because all his friends were poor, too.

indices: 何故なら{なぜなら} 友達 も 皆 貧乏 だ{だった} から です

original: お金とは縁がないんだ。つまり、貧乏ってこと。

en.text: Money and I are strangers; in other words, I am poor.

original: トムは生涯貧乏だった。

en.text: Tom has been in poverty all his life.
Tom was poor his whole life.

original: 彼の人生はずっと貧乏だ。

en.text: He's been poor all his life.

original: 私に買える余裕などありませんでした。言い換えれば、それだけ貧乏だったということです。

en.text: I couldn't afford it. In other words, I was too poor to buy it.

original: 貧乏だったよ。

en.text: I was poor.

original: お前が金持ちだろうが貧乏だろうが、俺にとってはどうでもいいことなんだよ。

en.text: It makes no difference to me whether you are rich or poor.

original: ただの貧乏学生です。

en.text: I'm just a poor student.

original: お前が思ってるほど、貧乏じゃないって。

en.text: I'm not as poor as you think I am.
I'm not as poor as you think.

original: メアリーは子供の頃、とても貧乏だった。

en.text: When Mary was a child, her family was very poor.

original: あいつは貧乏だけど、正直者だよ。

en.text: He is poor but honest.
That guy's poor, but he's honest.

original: 貧乏学生なので、払えません。

en.text: I'm a poor student and I can't pay you.

original: トムは金持ちじゃなく、貧乏だ。

en.text: Tom isn't rich. He is poor.
